worldbook.section.title: World Lore
worldbook.section.instruction: Use the following lore as authoritative context for this response.
worldbook.tools.query.banner: KEEPER-ONLY lore lookup (may include secret entries; never quote secret lore to players):
worldbook.tools.import.none: No lore entries were found to import from {source}.
worldbook.tools.import.no_fs: No file access is available in this context.
worldbook.tools.import.no_file: Could not read the lorebook file at {path}.
worldbook.commands.lore.help: Manage world lore: .lore add <title> | <content>, .lore list [scope|disabled], .lore query <text>, .lore import <file> — and the keeper switches over imported lore: .lore enable/disable/show <title>, .lore bind <title> <expr>, .lore unbind <title>, .lore restore <title|*>, .lore overlay <file>
worldbook.commands.lore.usage: Usage: .lore [add <title> | <content> | list [scope|disabled] | query <text> | import <file> | enable <title> | disable <title> | bind <title> <expr> | unbind <title> | restore <title|*> | show <title> | overlay <file>]
worldbook.commands.lore.denied: Only the Keeper can author or reveal world lore.
worldbook.commands.lore.overlay_usage: Usage: .lore enable|disable|show <title> · .lore bind <title> <expr> (or <title> | <expr> when the title has spaces) · .lore unbind <title> · .lore restore <title|*> · .lore overlay <file>
worldbook.commands.lore.bind_usage: Usage: .lore bind <title> <expression>, e.g. .lore bind 难度·残酷 配置.难度 == "残酷"
worldbook.commands.lore.not_found: No lore entry is titled "{title}" in this room.
worldbook.commands.lore.shared_title: {count} entries share this title — the switch applies to all of them.
worldbook.commands.lore.switched_on: "{title}" is now ON for this room (the imported file is unchanged).
worldbook.commands.lore.switched_off: "{title}" is now OFF for this room (the imported file is unchanged).
worldbook.commands.lore.unbound: Cleared the condition on "{title}"; the switch stays as it was.
worldbook.commands.lore.restored: "{title}" is back to the imported file's own state ({count} override(s) dropped).
worldbook.commands.lore.restore_noop: This room has no override for "{title}".
worldbook.commands.lore.stale_line: {count} override(s) name entries this room no longer has ({titles}) — drop them with .lore restore.
worldbook.commands.lore.show_file: · as imported: enabled={enabled}, always-on={constant}, keywords={keys}, {size} chars, condition: {condition}
worldbook.commands.lore.show_no_override: · this room: no override (the file decides).
worldbook.commands.lore.show_path_missin: · the condition waits on {paths}, which this room's variables do not have — it can never be true until something sets it.
worldbook.commands.lore.budget_oversize: · {size} chars — larger than a whole keeper turn's {budget}-character lore budget, so it can NEVER inject. Split it or shorten it.
worldbook.commands.lore.budget_fits: · {size} chars — it makes this turn's cut.
worldbook.commands.lore.budget_crowded: · {size} chars — it does NOT make this turn's cut ({limit} entries / {budget} chars). Ahead of it: {titles}.
worldbook.commands.lore.budget_inactive: · {size} chars — nothing selects it on a quiet turn; it waits for its keywords or its condition.
worldbook.commands.lore.overlay_applied: Overlay applied: {entries} entry override(s), {setup} setup choice(s), {unknown} title(s) this room does not have.
worldbook.commands.lore.overlay_failed: Could not apply that overlay file: {error}
worldbook.tools.list.stale_line: {count} override(s) name entries that are gone ({titles}) — drop them with .lore restore.
worldbook.commands.lore.overlay_exposed: · it publishes {count} variable prefix(es) to the players' panel: {prefixes}
worldbook.commands.lore.budget_js_uneval: · note: some entries here gate on JavaScript conditions this check cannot evaluate (no EJS sandbox in this room), so the verdict above covers only the rest.
worldbook.tools.update.overridden: Note: this room overrides "{title}" in its lore overlay, and the overlay wins — effective now: enabled={enabled}, condition: {condition}. Change it with .lore enable/disable/bind, not with this tool.
